# blackbox-bench

A lightweight Python microbenchmarking library with a Rust core (PyO3).

## Top-level exports
- blackbox_bench.Bench(warmup, target_time_ns, iterations, confidence_level,
  outlier_method, overhead_subtract, histogram, seed)
- blackbox_bench.benchmark — module-level decorator
- blackbox_bench.black_box — opaque pass-through (prevents constant folding)
- blackbox_bench.BenchmarkResult — frozen result class with statistical fields
- blackbox_bench.HdrHistogram — opt-in HDR histogram
- blackbox_bench.compare(baseline_json, current_json) -> ComparisonReport
- blackbox_bench.Runner — low-level entry point (usually not needed)

## CLI

```
blackbox-bench run [PATH] [--warmup N] [--iterations N] [--target-time-ns N]
            [--format {table,json,html,xml}] [--xml-style {junit,raw}]
            [--output FILE] [--save FILE] [--profile]
blackbox-bench compare BASELINE CURRENT [--format ...] [--output FILE]
```

## Features

- Per-batch timing with auto-batch-sizing
- Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals
- Tukey / MAD outlier detection
- Harness-overhead measurement and subtraction
- Setup-isolated benchmarks (iter_batched)
- Throughput, parameterized benchmarks, HDR histograms
- HTML / JUnit-XML / JSON / table reporters
- CI-based regression classifier (unchanged / regressed / improved / new / removed)
- py-spy flamegraph integration via --profile
